name: Poly Edge E Series
description: Poly/Polycom XML attribute configuration plus a contact directory.

sip.username.description: SIP user / auth id. Resolved from the extension when left empty.

sip.password.description: SIP secret. Resolved from the extension when left empty.

sip.domain.description: SIP registrar / domain the phone registers to.

user.display_name.description: Caller ID name shown on the device.

device.mac.description: Device MAC address, used for the configuration filename.

outputs.template:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<!-- Generated by Oryk Provisioner for {{device.name}} ({{device.mac_colon}}) -->
<PHONE_CONFIG>
  <ALL
    reg.1.address="{{sip.username}}@{{sip.domain}}"
    reg.1.auth.userId="{{sip.auth_username}}"
    reg.1.auth.password="{{sip.password}}"
    reg.1.label="{{user.display_name}}"
    reg.1.displayName="{{user.display_name}}"
    reg.1.type="private"
    reg.1.server.1.address="{{sip.domain}}"
    reg.1.server.1.port="{{sip.port}}"
    reg.1.server.1.transport="{{#if sip.secure}}TLS{{else}}{{sip.transport|upper}}Only{{/if}}"
    reg.1.server.1.expires="{{sip.register_expires|default:300}}"
    msg.mwi.1.subscribe="{{sip.username}}"
    msg.mwi.1.callBackMode="contact"
    msg.mwi.1.callBack="{{sip.voicemail_number|default:*97}}"
    device.prov.serverName="{{provisioning.root_url}}"
    tcpIpApp.sntp.address="{{system.ntp_server|default:pool.ntp.org}}"
  />
</PHONE_CONFIG>
